title: Three Weeks and One Short Knife
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：leather　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 leather 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1961 the tanner ① bought the leather that no buyer in the workshop would have recorded, and he said the buying was the whole of the week. The ② leather, meaning the hide itself and not the knife, ran three weeks and stayed unrecorded in the book; leather, he said, is the only thing in a workshop that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ kind of leather in that workshop had the same short knife beside it, and the ④ leather at the far rack, meaning the strap they kept for the children to cut and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Leather, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the tanner said the recording is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the leather was the whole of the matter, meaning the habit and not the hide. The ⑥ leather, meaning the habit and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; leather, he said, is either something you buy or the only word that means both hide and a habit. He said the habit is the part they remember.

By 1966 the ⑦ leather had become a line in an invoice, and the invoice had become an argument about the short knife. The ⑧ leather of the whole thing, the tanner wrote in April, was one workshop and three weeks of recording; leather, he said, is either the strap at the far rack or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ leather I remember is the leather recorded in the invoice, which closed in 1968 and is still recorded as the quietest in the workshop. ⑩ Leather, my mother said in 1970, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; all leather, she said, is a habit that has agreed to look like hide. She said the habit was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 皮革；皮料（指作坊里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 皮革；皮料（指那种皮革本身，与刮刀相对）
C. 固定搭配：buy the leather 买进这类皮革
D. n. 皮革；皮料（指留给孩子们裁下的那一条那一种）
E. n. 皮货之事（抽象总称，指一处作坊的皮革之事）
F. n. 皮革；皮料（指发票里写到、被记载的的那一种）
G. n. 习惯、手艺（指一件事里人人都买却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 手艺（抽象总称，指人人都买却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: bought the leather that no buyer in the workshop would have recorded
The leather, meaning the hide itself and not the knife
Every kind of leather in that workshop
the leather at the far rack

answers.why: buy the leather 意为“买进这类皮革”，1961 年那位鞣皮匠把作坊里没有一位买主肯记载的一种皮革做了一遍。
leather 意为“皮革；皮料”，指那种皮革本身而不是刮刀，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被记载。
leather 意为“皮革；皮料”，指作坊里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一把小小的刮刀。
leather 意为“皮革；皮料”，指最远那排木架留给孩子们裁下的那一条那一种，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
leather 意为“习惯、手艺”，指一件事里人人都买却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这门手艺就是那件事的全部。
leather 意为“手艺”，指人人都买却无人提起的那样东西而不是那种皮革，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
leather 意为“皮革；皮料”，指发票里写到、被记载的的那一种，到 1966 年这一种成了发票里的一行。
leather 意为“皮货之事”，鞣皮匠四月写道，整件事的皮革之事是一处作坊和三个星期的记载。
leather 意为“皮革；皮料”，我记得的是发票里记载过的那一种，1968 年谈定了，至今仍被说成作坊里最安静的一种。
leather 为抽象总称，母亲 1970 年说，皮革是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的皮革。
